story_type: sailboat sinks on a reef, four men in a life raft, fishermen and a container ship pick them up
hook: Their sailboat hit a rock and sank. Four men, one raft.
narration: Four men, adrift in a life raft.
Their sailboat, Mariposa, had struck a rock north of the Dominican Republic. A wave rolled it, another rock breached the hull, and it sank.
Overhead, a Coast Guard plane from Puerto Rico had followed an emergency beacon signal out to Silver Bank.
[short pause] The aircrew found the raft in shallow water, and made low passes over a fishing boat named Bonanza to get its attention.
Far offshore, the nearest help is often a passing vessel, so rescue crews call ships to the scene.
Bonanza's crew reached the raft in the shoals and pulled all four men out.
Then it carried them to El Coqui, a seven hundred twenty foot container ship that had turned to help.
outcome: All four men climbed aboard the El Coqui, and no medical concerns were reported.

location_card.place: Silver Bank, north of the Dominican Republic

title: Sailboat sank, four men in a life raft
description:
On Jan. 21, 2025, the sailing vessel Mariposa struck rocks and sank in the Silver Bank area north of the Dominican Republic. A Coast Guard HC-144 aircrew found the four men in their life raft, the fishing vessel Bonanza picked them up, and the container ship El Coqui took them aboard.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of U.S. Coast Guard Southeast, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/950252/coast-guard-responding-vessels-rescue-4-us-boaters-life-raft-atlantic-ocean
